nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Quick Clay Stick Mask

avis.texte: I really liked this product at first but ive gone through it pretty quickly and haven't had it that long. IMO not worth replenishing so soon
This mask is so convenient and easy to use. Its pore cleansing and helps to get rid of excess sebum on skin. Love thatbis is multi-use and does not harden in between uses.

I'm pleasantly surprised by this mask. The stick format is super convenient and hygienic. It applies evenly and doesn't feel heavy on the skin. After 10–15 minutes, my pores look visibly cleaner and my skin feels smoother and balanced. I also love that it doesn't over-dry my face. Great option for oily or combination skin.

avis.titre: Seems expensive for what it is
avis.texte: I really didn't see any benefits from using this. I have super dry and sensitive skin so I usually don't use a whole lot of products. This just seems to be one more thing to add to a routine that I don't really have time for.

The Centella Quick Clay Stick Mask surprised me in the best way. It's mess-free, gentle, and incredibly convenient. The twist-up stick glides smoothly, coating my skin evenly without any tugging or waste. I love how it detoxes pores while keeping my skin calm and hydrated - no tight or dry feeling afterward. The Centella in it really soothes redness, and my face feels instantly fresher and smoother after rinsing. It's perfect for busy mornings or nights when I want a quick reset without the hassle of traditional clay masks. My favorite part is the cooling touch when applying - it feels like a mini facial in seconds. Simple, effective, and totally worth keeping in my skincare routine.
The texture is really smooth and easy to apply. It's gentle and also wash off easily. After rinsing, my skin feels soft and comfortable, not drying and I notice that my pores look smoother.

This clay mask has to be one of the best. The stick application makes it so easy to use, it seems like such an obvious solution to usually messy clay masks. Plus it actually works, I instantly noticed smaller pores and brighter skin. Wonderful product!

First I'll say I loved the stick form of the clay. All masks should come in this form. Easy to apply and I noticed changes after the first use. My skin feels tighter and softer. And I love the slight exfoliation. My face didn't feel stripped or dry and my pore seem slightly smaller. I can't wait to see the long term effects.

avis.titre: Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Quick Clay Stick Mask
avis.texte: Easy to use and completely mess-free, this clay stick mask applies smoothly and feels gentle on the skin. It cleanses without over-drying or tightening. After rinsing, my skin feels fresh and smooth, and my pores look more refined
My pores looked visibly smaller and reduced black heads. The mask drys quickly and very easy to use in a stick form, no mess.

I enjoyed using this clay mask stick, I love that it's soo easy to use and it's not messy at all! It comes in a stick with a lid and a stopper that goes on top of the stick before placing the lid back on. I liked that my face didn't feel dry or tight when using it. I noticed a slight difference in my pore size but not sure if it's permanent. Either way it's a lovely product!

I got this as a sample but I absolutely love this. I've been using it for about two weeks now and I have noticed the difference it has made in my large pores near my nose area. I've been recommending it, a very affordable price as well

avis.titre: I will recommend this to everyone I possibly can and I would
avis.texte: I used Madagascar face mask, I really like how it fits my face needs/it clears my skin off of acne and every other impurity. I will definitely purchase it again, as well as recommended to other neighbors, relatives, friends, and anyone I could possibly recommend it too.

I had the opportunity to try this product for free through BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review and this product is extremely easy to use for beginners. Most clay masks have a learning curve with the application due to the texture but SKIN1004 making it into a stick has made the process SO EASY. You literally just apply to the face like you would stick anything. It goes on very smooth, dries quickly. I found the product made my skin dry so when I applied the rest of my skincare it all was soaked in nicely. It gave my skin a nice prep. Overall, i would recommend this product!

I love this product! The stick makes application easy, mess free and less time consuming! I'm a mom of 3 so not much time for myself but now with this stick I can at least have a little routine to myself. Mask dries fast so I don't have to worry about my little ones getting their hands dirty trying to touch my face! I've seen a noticeable difference with the pores on my nose! Love this product!

The first time I used this, I only used it where my pores are the largest. Followed the instructions and what I noticed is my face didn't feel tight. A lot of pore minimizing masks I've used, they tend to feel tight, like all of my oils are being stripped. This pore minimizing mask still made my skin feel soft. I wouldn't say it really shrunk the appearance of my pores, but after continued use, I'm sure I will notice a big difference.

avis.titre: Easy to use and works well!
avis.texte: I have been looking for a new clay mask to keep up with my changing skin and had the opportunity to try this product for free through BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review . First of all, I LOVE the packaging. It's very simple, pretty and easy to use. I love that the mask is in stick form and the seal on the tube is tight, so no product dry out. The clay covers evenly and drys relatively fast. Washing the product off was a breeze since it layered so evenly. My skin didn't feel hydrated, but it wasn't dry. It felt soft and I felt it created a good base for my other skin care products to absorb into my skin better. Overall, I really like the convenience of this product and will certainly buy some more when I run out!

The Poremizing Quick Clay Stick Mask has definitely changed my perspective on clay masks forever! One of the first things I like about this mask is that it is in Stick form! It is so easy to rub on and one thing I hate is to apply product directly onto my hands and then have a hard time removing it but not with this Stick type mask! It is soft and most and smoothly spreads on your skin! And yes, it's so easy to wash off!! It definitely deeply cleans your clogged pores without irritation. I'm a sensitive skin girly that deals with Eczema and i can tell you, this was safe on my skin. It's so surprising to learn it has 5 types of clays mixed into it with 18% kaolin and white mud that effectively soak up your excess sebum . My skin definitely felt smoother after I washed it off! I received this product for free in exchange for a review.
I like the way it made my face feel after I wash off the mask it felt so clean and refresh

avis.titre: Ehh didn't see a difference in my skin
avis.texte: I used this product as well as my husband did. It made our skin soft but didn't really do much after. We still use it but don't really notice a difference. The product is really smooth and has exfoliating beads in it as well.

As a nurse, my skin is always dry and dull. This on the go stick mask is one of my new favorite products and has truly transformed my skin. The mask is very easy to apply and takes just 3-5 minutes to see full effects. The packing of the mask also allows for a mess-free application. I apply this mask before leaving for work and leave it on for the full 5 minutes. After washing off the mask, my face is glowing and my pores appear minimized. I struggle with blackheads around my nose and chin, and this mask has helped to make them less noticeable. I would definitely purchase this product and recommend it to my family and friends! I received this product as a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: Love this and will more from this line
avis.texte: I absolutely love this mask. I have oily to combo skin and have large ish pores on my nose and cheeks. The packaging in stick form makes using this not messy. It dries quickly so I don't have to leave it on long and rinses easily. I noticed improvement of my pore size after the 2nd use. My skin doesn't feel tight like after other clay masks. It's especially helpful before makeup to keep it from settling in pores. I would definitely try other products from the line as well.

This is a wonderful mask! So easy to use if you are a mom minutes count! And this is the fastest way I have ever seen to apply it and 0 mess with the stick! 5 minutes and then rinse and I was feeling my face so clean, light and soft! Pores are still visible but is way less!
The clay is good to use no brushed or scoop needed. Applies gently and washes off easily. Skin looks smoother and less shiny.

avis.titre: Easy to Use, Gentle, and Effective – Loved It!
avis.texte: I received the Madagascar Centella Pore minimizing Quick Clay Stick Mask from BzzAgent for free to try, and it's amazing! The stick format makes it so easy and mess-free to apply. After using it, my skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed, and my pores look less noticeable. I love that it's gentle with Centella and Aloe Vera, so it doesn't irritate my skin. Perfect for a quick pampering session! I'll definitely keep it in my routine.

I love the fact that this is a stick! It applies easily and smoothly with no messes. It is super soft on the skin and i don't feel dried out like other clay masks. My skin texture look and feel better after a week and change of usage.

avis.titre: I would buy this product I love it!
avis.texte: It's very easy to use and covers the face easily and gives your skin a nice glow and texture is smooth I love this and would recommend it for the best clay mask.

I received the Madagascar Centella Pore-Minimizing Quick Clay Stick Mask as a sample and I absolutely love it! I'm 34 with combination skin and hormonal acne, and after using it twice I'm honestly blown away. I tried it on a breakout day and it significantly reduced the inflammation. The stick application is genius. Like, why wasn't this thought of sooner? No mess, no brushes, no clay all over your hands. Just swipe and done. My skin felt calm, clean, and tighter without feeling dry. I'm obsessed already and highly recommend it!

I received this product in exchange for an honest review, all opinions are mine. This mask is different from other clay masks I've used,it goes on very smooth and it is refreshing. Another key point that makes it better than other is how easy it is to remove, and, my most favorite thing: it does not make your skin dry or tight! I disliked using clay masks because of how uncomfortable my skin felt after rinsing it, so I'm pleasantly surprised on how different my skin feels after using this mask, my skin feels soft and refreshed! Make sure to always put back the cover it comes with, it keeps the mask soft!

The mask is super easy and convenient to use. I like how it seamlessly glides over your skin to create a thin, uniform layer. The texture within the product make it a fun experience. It dries pretty quickly for a no mess wear, and removes easily with a wipe. Left my skin feeling smooth. My only issue is that there isn't that much product, the tall packaging is deceiving. I snapped a photo of the product rolled all the way up, and its less than half the packaging.

I really enjoyed this mask. I have dry spots around my nose but have an oily t-zone. The exfoliating bits help with the dry spots and the overall formula helps with reducing oil and is calming and not irritating. I really like that its in a stick which makes it travel friendly but also so that application is less messy. Its really easy to wash off which is also nice because sometimes masks hold on for dear life and you find random areas of dried mask in your hairline that were missed. Or maybe thats just me? Either way I think this is a stellar add to my routine.

This clay mask stick was something different I liked how it felt on my skin and it definitely did clean up my clogged pours that I had, it didn't give any harsh chemical smell its fragrance free. It also left my skin soft. Pretty packaging shiny letters.

Noticeably difference after the first use. Product goes on like butter and leaves my skin brighter and glowy. Im skeptical of mask like this because they never seem to work but this one knocks it out of the park!

This product is great for use two times a week keeps skin smooth pores blurred and clear love that it is in a stick form for a no mess application and is the perfect consistency to go on smoothly all over face

This mask was great! I love the ease of the stick and how it doesn't make a mess and I don't feel like I'm wasting product all over my hands. I struggle with larger pores so this is great at helping minimize them and getting rid of any impurities. Will definitely repurchase.

avis.titre: Beware of Blue Mold on Clay Stick
avis.texte: I ordered this online because of the videos claiming it works on sensitive skin. Upon opening it, there were blue spots, mold, around the clay stick. I threw it away and not worth the risk.

I was really impressed with this clay stick mask! It applies so smoothly, the stick glides over the skin without tugging and makes it super easy to use. Even though it exfoliates, it feels surprisingly gentle. After rinsing, my skin felt soft, clean, and refreshed without that tight, dry feeling most clay masks leave behind. I also noticed my pores looked noticeably minimized and smoother, especially around my nose and cheeks. Overall, it's an easy, mess-free clay mask that actually delivers

The Poremizing Quick Clay Stick Mask has definitely changed my perspective on clay masks forever! I'm used to the clay masks from the 90s that used to stay stuck on your skin and then you had to peel them off with a paint scraper. Lol well that's why I have been so nervous to try any clay mall. But let me tell you, this one is gold! One of the first things I like about this mask is that it is in Stick form! It is so easy to rub on and one thing I hate is to apply product directly onto my hands and then have a hard time removing it but not with this Stick type mask! It is soft and most and smoothly spreads on your skin! And yes, it's so easy to wash off!! It definitely deeply cleans your clogged pores without irritation. I'm a sensitive skin girly that deals with Eczema and i can tell you, this was safe on my skin. It's so surprising to learn it has 5 types of clays mixed into it with 18% kaolin and white mud that effectively soak up your excess sebum . My skin definitely felt smoother after I washed it off!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I was a little skeptical of this clay mask at first because generally they don't work for me. I was wrong on this one. After first use I noticed smaller, clearer pores. It also gives a smoothing effect which is really nice. My boyfriend struggles with enlarged pores more than me and tried this product and is in love with it. This clay mask goes on very easily and its buttery smooth texture makes this product glide on the skin. It dries quickly and washes off with little effort. It brightens and tightens! The stick applicator makes this product convenient and easy to apply. Its small size makes it easy to take on trips. I really do enjoy this product.
Honestly, more masks should come in this form. So easy to use and very soothing on the skin. Loved this!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I loved this product again. If anyone is looking for one, I recommend it one hundred percent. It leaves the skin super clean and completely oil-free, very clean.

I received this product for free as a sample in exchange for my honest review. The stick format keeps the application clean and effortless — no brushes or scoops needed. It applies evenly, dries gently, and washes off easily. My skin looks smoother and less shiny afterward, especially around the T-zone. It's convenient, quick, and ideal for days when I want a simple, low-effort clay mask. I'd consider purchasing it for the ease of use and portability, and would recommend it to anyone who prefers a cleaner, faster clay-mask routine.

avis.titre: this mask is really wonderful for oily skin!
avis.texte: i am honestly a huge fan of this clay mask. i've heard of really good things about the brand before but this is my first product i tried. first the application is great. it's so clean and just avoids the usual mess with face masks which i love. i felt like as a girl with oily skin this was really great for my pores and i just felt like my skin was really clean and felt like it had actually helped with my pores. highly recommend as a weekly mask!!! Centella kindly gave me this madagascar poreminimizing quick clay stick mask for free so that I could review it.

avis.titre: Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Quick Clay Stick Mask
avis.texte: The Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Quick Clay Stick Mask is a compact and super effective addition to my skincare routine. I received this product as a free sample and I love it!
AAAA THIS IS THE BESTT! after trying this i really want to buy the whole centella things because its been helpful for my skin as it looks so freakin magicslly poreless and so smooth.
Loved how easy this mask was to use and how amazing it made my skin feel.
My pores tightened immediately! Love the product and the price!
